title: 证据 6 — jobs.pid 从不落库：agent 知道真实 pid，数据库里永远是 NULL

steps.say: 起 server 与 agent，然后提交一个短任务

steps.run: sh qa/harness/server-up.sh false && sh qa/harness/agent-up.sh qa-node-01

steps.say: 登录拿 token → 提交任务 → 等它跑完，然后同时看 agent 日志与数据库

steps.run: T=$(curl -s -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"username":"admin","password":"admin123"}' http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/login | jq -r .access_token); J=$(curl -s -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $T" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"node_id":"qa-node-01","name":"qa-pid-demo","executable":"/bin/sh","arguments":["-c","echo qa-pid-demo; sleep 3"],"working_directory":"/tmp"}' http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/jobs | jq -r .job_id); echo "job_id=$J"; sleep 10; echo '--- agent 日志（它知道真实 pid）---'; grep -h 'Process spawned' gauntlet-out/qa/agent.log | sed 's/\x1b\[[0-9;]*m//g' | tail -1; echo '--- 数据库行（pid 是 NULL，尽管任务 succeeded）---'; /public/tianyuyang/code/ClusterScope-review/pg16/bin/psql 'postgresql://clusterscope:clusterscope@127.0.0.1:5432/clusterscope' -tAc "select job_id || ' | ' || status || ' | pid=' || coalesce(pid::text,'NULL') from jobs where job_id='$J'"

steps.say: 根因：grpc.rs 调 update_job_status 时 pid 位置恒传字面量 None（同一个函数的 exit_code / started_at 也是 None）

steps.run: sed -n '497,508p' crates/server/src/grpc.rs; /public/tianyuyang/code/ClusterScope-review/pg16/bin/psql 'postgresql://clusterscope:clusterscope@127.0.0.1:5432/clusterscope' -tAc "select 'jobs=' || count(*) || ' with_pid=' || count(pid) from jobs;"

steps.say: 顺带一个同类结论：retry_count / max_retries 没有任何代码路径会写非 0 值，失败任务永不重试
